observations.dispatch_rule: prev = sentinel; node = receiver; for i in 1..9: node = [node + 0x38]; t = slot(node); if i == 9 or t != prev: tail-jump to t with rdi = node; else prev = t. The receiver's own slot is never read; the differing slot receives every original argument unchanged except rdi.

unknowns: Domain meaning of the chain and the three slots is not claimed.
The dispatched slots are class-dependent virtual functions; their implementations are left by contract.
The three non-global RELATIVE slots per sentinel are .data.rel.ro entries; which classes' vtables they belong to is not claimed.
Indirect-branch callers, if any, are not covered by the census; the census covers direct calls, tail jumps, stored qwords, and RELATIVE addends only.
A chain that ends before the dispatch resolves is not modelled as a return: the native code would dereference a null vtable pointer, so the model raises instead of inventing a result.
